guides.favoredWhen: Annoying vs a good Azir. He Ws before R to dodge yours, kills after Voltaic, never Rs near tower.

keyTips.text: He finds you annoying: a good Azir keeps him out, so hold the line.
He Ws before R to dodge yours after ulting: hold R until the shadow lands.
He looks for kills after Voltaic: end it before the spike.

early-lane.text: Zed often places Living Shadow before Death Mark so he can swap away from skillshots. Hold your crowd control until he has used the swap.

win-condition.text: Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.

tips.text: He gives you prio and looks for Ignite all-ins: respect the sums.
He WEQs when you Q, positioned to cut off your E: Q from max range.
Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.
He refuses to R near your tower: your R shoves him in, so hold it for dives.
R held plus soldiers placed: the Zed whose shadow never dodges never kills.

keyTips.text: Cover weak base early damage with repeated soldier harass instead of hunting early burst.
Keep Shifting Sands plus a standing soldier ready as the only escape route against ganks.
Group harder for late objectives while still catching side waves when safe.

tips.text: Slide soldiers through the opponent with Q and follow with an auto as the basic short trade.
On Hail of Blades, spend its available attacks inside the trade instead of stopping after one hit.
Expect weaker early trading on the scaling Lethal Tempo page than on Comet or Hail of Blades setups.
Build lane priority through harass in most lanes, with Xerath and Yone named as the lanes that can contest it.
Preserve a Sand Soldier whenever possible so E keeps a retreat dash target.
After laning, push a side lane into its turret, then regroup with the team.
Ward around the side lane before extending, since getting caught erases pressure everywhere else.
During a siege, plant a soldier behind Azir to feed the extra attack-speed effect and hold an E escape line.
Drop the passive turret near the end of a side siege as another defensive layer.
With Teleport, set up opposite the next objective to threaten a side wave and still join; without it, stay on the objective side.
Never enter unwarded ground late, since one pick can cost an objective or the game.

itemization.text: Build Liandry's Torment into Sorcerer's Shoes, Nashor's Tooth, Void Staff, Rabadon's Deathcap, and Zhonya's Hourglass, with Banshee's Veil as an option.
Take the Liandry's route into frontline or health stacking, and the Shadowflame route into squishier teams.
Buy Seeker's Armguard into Zhonya's Hourglass against dive or attack-damage threats, and Verdant Barrier into Banshee's Veil against crowd control or pick threats.
Run the scaling page of Lethal Tempo with Presence of Mind, Legend: Alacrity, and Cut Down, plus Manaflow Band and Gathering Storm.
